notes.subject: sehlaho sa kotlhoho
notes.rationale: 'Sackcloth' ha se ka Seheberu moeleele; mongolo o bua feela ka ho ikgarilla — liphetolelo tse ngata di eketsa sehlaho

notes.subject: שאננות/בטחות
notes.rationale: Kgethollo pakeng tsa 'ba phomotseng' le 'ba tshepeng' — mehopolo e mmedi e tshwanang, e thehilweng ho Isa 32:9-10

notes.subject: basali ba Judaea
notes.rationale: Taelo e tobileng ho basali ba phomotseng — ditaolo tsa sesotho ka bomang

notes.subject: mealane
notes.rationale: חלצים ke 'sehla sa matla' — 'mealane' kapa 'mothaladi'; mealane e kgethwa bakeng sa sebaka sa ho ikgarilla

translation: Tshabang, lona basali ba phomotseng; tsamaiswang ke tshabo, lona ba tshepeng: apolang hlole, mme heolang hlole, mme ikgarille ⟨sehlaho sa kotlhoho⟩ holimo ga mealane.
